what_i_did: The turnaround labels are right (front and side show the door, back shows the swing), but each crop had the sheet's shadow band and a sliver of the neighbouring tree; prep_views.py cleans them into views/ and scoring uses that folder.

A custom swept spline (Catmull-Rom, parallel-transport frames) tapering from 2.55 m to 0.42 m, with five flutes twisting 1.1 turns. It follows the hero's big S: hard right at the base (+2.3 m), back left through the middle (-1.2 m), right again into the crown. The flared base is about 5 m wide and swallows the door; four tapered roots.

Three tiers of cloud pads. Each pad is 6 to 9 overlapping flattened UV-sphere puffs of varied size, smooth shaded: a raised central dome, then a ring of smaller lumps with squashed, rounded undersides that make a bulging lip, so no edge is a vertical wall. The crown is 9.9 m wide and 2.7 m deep (3.6:1). Up-facing faces get LeafLight.
Each pad sits on its own tapered swept arm from the trunk, with two forked twigs reaching into the pad.
The low branch reaches 5.6 m out to the left with its own small plate. The two knotted ropes and the bevelled seat hang 3.7 m from it, well clear of the trunk.
Arched red plank door with iron hinges and knob in a dark recess between two roots at the front (-Y), a grass disc, bushes, rocks and a stepping-stone path to the door.
Art-director palette, stored exactly in the GLB (sRGB hex converted to linear with c^2.2): Leaf #4F8A3C, LeafLight #7DAF55, Bark #8B7A70, Grass #5E9A3F.
good: Plump S-twisting trunk with root flare and the door at its roots reads as the hero's storybook tree.
Tiered flat-bottomed cloud pads with a lighter top and a leafy fringe give the bonsai and cloud look.
7,625 triangles (under the 8k budget), 14.6 m tall, origin at trunk base on the ground, front faces -Y.
off: The pads are smooth puff clusters. The hero's carved swirl relief and fine leaf texture are not modelled.

Mean IoU fell from 0.570 to 0.506 over the art-director rounds. Following the hero's wide S-gesture, its far-out swing and rounder pad lumps moves the silhouette away from the turnaround, which draws a narrower, straighter four-tier tree with spiky leaf fringes and the swing close to the trunk (back view 0.42).
The greens are now mid-green, but the shading between lobes is shallower than the hero's sculpted canopy.
The bark has no grooves or streaks beyond the twisted flutes.

After round 8, at the art director's request, the 0.72/0.85 pre-darkening was reverted so the GLB holds the true palette; the harness's bright lighting makes the final renders look more lime than the palette (a harness lighting issue, not the asset).

rounds.change: First build: swept twisted trunk, 5 thin puff pads, swing, door, base (8,397 tris, over budget).
Taller tree (pads raised ~1 m), thicker pads, darker greens and bark, smaller ground disc, fewer root/bush polys to get under budget (7,453 tris).
Added the scalloped drooping leaf fringe under every pad and plumped the lower trunk.
Widened the crown to 5 m radius (hero), widened right pad, pushed left pad forward (-Y).
Kept the wide crown, reverted the left pad's depth move (it cost side IoU).
Brought the door forward out of the trunk so the red planks show; final 768 px / 48 sample render.

Art-director round: S-trunk amplitude about 2.5x, longer trunk and 5 m flared base, canopy rebuilt as flat 4:1 lobed plates in 3 tiers with stacked inset scallop rings, 10 m-wide crown, swing branch 5.6 m out to the left with its own plate, AD palette, fewer roots and bushes; final 768 px / 48 sample render.

Art-director round 2: pads rebuilt as clusters of 6 to 9 flattened, overlapping puffs with domed tops and rounded underside lips (dropped the slabs and fringe skirts); crown 3.6:1; leaf, grass and bark inputs pre-darkened to compensate for the harness lighting (greens now mid, not lime); final 768 px / 48 sample render.

notes.moving_parts: Every pad and its branch hangs under its own pivot (sway_crown, sway_left, sway_right, sway_back, sway_swing) at the branch root. Each one sways 1.6 to 2.6 degrees on two axes with offset phases. The rope swing (swing_pivot, a child of sway_swing) swings +-22 degrees about its branch, twice per loop. Frames 1 to 120 at 24 fps, all sine-based, so the loop is seamless, and it exports as one 'Scene' clip.
notes.creative_additions: Stepping-stone path leading to the door, iron hinges and a knob on the door, knots where the swing ropes meet the branch, small bushes and rocks around the roots, a back plate so the tree reads in the round, and the swing riding on its swaying branch (the hierarchy makes the two motions combine).
